### Explore the machinery

Raise the fire and use **Run 10 s** until the throttle can open. Let the rollers turn, then feed a stalk. **Cane path** reveals the feed bed, both nips, the bagasse discharge and the open juice tray. The front of the cylinder housing is deliberately removed: **Engine detail** shows a solid ringed piston inside the bore, its rod passing through the gland, the guided crosshead and the eccentric crank pin. Pause or scrub the crank to inspect their connections. **Gear detail** isolates the 20:104 involute pair. Inspection isolates the mill; it does not make metal transparent.

This is an ideal teaching model. Rod lengths, joint positions, gear phases and the cane route share the same model. Heating, pressure and juice accumulation are qualitative; no calibrated boiler performance or extraction yield is implied.
title: Steam-powered cane mill
before: A working chain from steam to sugar cane: the sectioned cylinder drives a guided crosshead and crank; the steel pinion turns the larger brass wheel, which drives the three crushing rollers. Explore the cylinder, gear pair and continuous cane path using the detail views.
caption: Follow steam to the piston, through the crank and a 20:104 involute reduction, into a three-roller cane mill.
